Question ID: MAR_U02_L05_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.CHEM.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Salinity, Density, and Water Properties
Stimulus: Salinity/density data

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the physical or chemical variable. Then use the required stimulus (Salinity/density data) to connect the visible evidence to physical and chemical ocean conditions shown by models, graphs, and data. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.CHEM.01 and avoids this common mistake: describing ocean conditions without connecting the data to depth, motion, density, chemistry, or climate.
